newsitem.title: UK: Siebe leads sector lower as stg rebounds.
newsitem.headline: Siebe leads sector lower as stg rebounds.

text.p: Shares in Britain's Siebe Plc led UK engineering stocks lower on Tuesday as sterling rebounded against the mark, dealers said.
At 1123 GMT, the shares were down 31p to 1127-1/2.
The currency rebounded after the Bundesbank signalled this morning that it would not tighten monetary policy when it set its repurchase tender at an unchanged fixed rate of three percent.
UK engineering shares have rebounded during the last month as sterling's relentless rise showed signs of faltering.
The strength in sterling has hurt engineering and other companies with large overseas earnings.
Dealers said Siebe shares were also undermined by talk that a major U.S. investment bank had a large sell order to complete. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
